verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents native invoicing and tracks open invoices, which feed its cash-flow forecast. Its MCP surface also exposes invoices and customers, so a basic receivables foundation exists within the product. However, nothing documents an AR aging report or a per-customer balance view. Missing for 10: documented AR aging report (buckets such as 30/60/90 days), per-customer outstanding balance view, AR subledger or report documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances

citations.quote: a week-by-week cash flow forecast built from your open invoices, bills and payroll
Puzzle's invoice editor lets you build a professional, branded invoice
